resources.string: Xbox Cloud Gaming with Better xCloud
Your Xbox account with Game Pass Ultimate
Forgets the account in Rift\'s browser

1. Sign in with the Microsoft account that has Game Pass Ultimate. xbox.com opens in Rift's browser and closes by itself once you are in.
2. The Cloud streaming tab appears on the home screen with the Game Pass cloud games.
3. A opens a game's page, “Play in the cloud” starts it. Select + Start opens the side panel with “End stream”.
Xbox Cloud Gaming is not available in every country; where it is not, it needs a VPN.
Built in: quality, controller-friendly menus, stats. Settings in the game\'s menu. By redphx, MIT license
